name: @dxjs/proto
description: Map a protobuf/gRPC service descriptor into @dxjs/transport MethodDescriptors (ADR 0001): a whole service becomes typed descriptors (ids, service/method names, wire.grpc hints, idempotency) in one call. Service MAP only — payload encoding is the caller's codec on grpcNativeAdapter/connectAdapter.
